optimizer.rationale: Development traces show H0 failed on controls_withheld because the inspect role failed after revision, while R0 completed; H0 also had unsupported_count 3 on full_sources. The failure appears tied to inspect attempting to resolve control availability and missing evidence. Splitting inspect into a pure evidence-inventory role and an upstream evidence-review role that explicitly handles missing controls should reduce failure risk and improve completeness. Validation could disprove this if the new topology does not improve completion on controls_withheld or increases unsupported_count.
